references.text: Joseph's sons complain that they have received too little land, which leads to Joshua's answer in verse 15
Joshua encourages the descendants of Joseph to clear the forest in the hill country, the same theme as in verse 15
The Rephaim are mentioned as one of the peoples in the land of Canaan whom Israel was to drive out
The Rephaim are described as a people of giants who lived in the land
Og, king of Bashan, was the last of the Rephaim, showing that they were a mighty people
And from Bashan, the remnant of the Rephaim is mentioned in connection with the distribution of the land
The Perizzites are mentioned among the peoples whom God would drive out of the land
The Perizzites are mentioned as one of the peoples who lived in the land during Jacob's time
